vendor/firebase.js bundles parts of the Firebase JavaScript SDK 12.19.0
(firebase/app, firebase/auth, firebase/firestore/lite), built with esbuild.

Copyright Google LLC
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0:
https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
Source: https://github.com/firebase/firebase-js-sdk

Rebuild: npm i firebase@12.19.0 esbuild, then bundle an entry that re-exports
initializeApp, getAuth, GoogleAuthProvider, signInWithPopup, signInWithRedirect,
getRedirectResult, signOut, onAuthStateChanged, getFirestore, doc, getDoc, setDoc
with: esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=firebase.js
